263	// GenerateSnippet creates a plain text summary from markdown content.
264	func (s *service) GenerateSnippet(content []byte, maxLength int) (string, error) {
265		root, err := s.parse(content)
266		if err != nil {
267			return "", err
268		}
269	
270		var buf strings.Builder
271		var lastNodeWasBlock bool
272	
273		err = gast.Walk(root, func(n gast.Node, entering bool) (gast.WalkStatus, error) {
274			if entering {
275				// Skip code blocks entirely (but keep inline code spans for snippet text)
276				switch n.Kind() {
277				case gast.KindCodeBlock, gast.KindFencedCodeBlock:
278					return gast.WalkSkipChildren, nil
279				default:
280					// Continue walking for other node types
281				}
282	
283				// Add space before block elements (except first)
284				switch n.Kind() {
285				case gast.KindParagraph, gast.KindHeading, gast.KindListItem, east.KindTableCell, east.KindTableRow, east.KindTableHeader:
286					if buf.Len() > 0 && lastNodeWasBlock {
287						buf.WriteByte(' ')
288					}
289				default:
290					// No space needed for other node types
291				}
292			}
293	
294			if !entering {
295				// Mark that we just exited a block element
296				switch n.Kind() {
297				case gast.KindParagraph, gast.KindHeading, gast.KindListItem, east.KindTableCell, east.KindTableRow, east.KindTableHeader:
298					lastNodeWasBlock = true
299				default:
300					// Not a block element
301				}
302				return gast.WalkContinue, nil
303			}
304	
305			lastNodeWasBlock = false
306	
307			// Extract text from various node types
308			switch node := n.(type) {
309			case *gast.Text:
310				segment := node.Segment
311				buf.Write(segment.Value(content))
312				if node.SoftLineBreak() {
313					buf.WriteByte(' ')
314				}
315			case *gast.AutoLink:
316				buf.Write(node.URL(content))
317				return gast.WalkSkipChildren, nil
318			case *mast.TagNode:
319				buf.WriteByte('#')
320				buf.Write(node.Tag)
321			default:
322				// Ignore other node types.
323			}
324	
325			// Stop walking if we've exceeded double the max length
326			// (we'll truncate precisely later)
327			if buf.Len() > maxLength*2 {
328				return gast.WalkStop, nil
329			}
330	
331			return gast.WalkContinue, nil
332		})
333	
334		if err != nil {
335			return "", err
336		}
337	
338		snippet := buf.String()
339	
340		// Truncate at word boundary if needed
341		if len(snippet) > maxLength {
342			snippet = truncateAtWord(snippet, maxLength)
343		}
344	
345		return strings.TrimSpace(snippet), nil
346	}

263	// GenerateSnippet creates a plain text summary from markdown content.
264	func (s *service) GenerateSnippet(content []byte, maxLength int) (string, error) {
265		root, err := s.parse(content)
266		if err != nil {
267			return "", err
268		}
269	
270		var buf strings.Builder
271		var lastNodeWasBlock bool
272	
273		err = gast.Walk(root, func(n gast.Node, entering bool) (gast.WalkStatus, error) {
274			if entering {
275				// Skip code blocks entirely (but keep inline code spans for snippet text)
276				switch n.Kind() {
277				case gast.KindCodeBlock, gast.KindFencedCodeBlock:
278					return gast.WalkSkipChildren, nil
279				default:
280					// Continue walking for other node types
281				}
282	
283				// Add space before block elements (except first)
284				switch n.Kind() {
285				case gast.KindParagraph, gast.KindHeading, gast.KindListItem, east.KindTableCell, east.KindTableRow, east.KindTableHeader:
286					if buf.Len() > 0 && lastNodeWasBlock {
287						buf.WriteByte(' ')
288					}
289				default:
290					// No space needed for other node types
291				}
292			}
293	
294			if !entering {
295				// Mark that we just exited a block element
296				switch n.Kind() {
297				case gast.KindParagraph, gast.KindHeading, gast.KindListItem, east.KindTableCell, east.KindTableRow, east.KindTableHeader:
298					lastNodeWasBlock = true
299				default:
300					// Not a block element
301				}
302				return gast.WalkContinue, nil
303			}
304	
305			lastNodeWasBlock = false
306	
307			// Extract text from various node types
308			switch node := n.(type) {
309			case *gast.Text:
310				segment := node.Segment
311				buf.Write(segment.Value(content))
312				if node.SoftLineBreak() {
313					buf.WriteByte(' ')
314				}
315			case *gast.AutoLink:
316				buf.Write(node.URL(content))
317				return gast.WalkSkipChildren, nil
318			case *mast.TagNode:
319				buf.WriteByte('#')
320				buf.Write(node.Tag)
321			default:
322				// Ignore other node types.
323			}
324	
325			// Stop walking if we've exceeded double the max length
326			// (we'll truncate precisely later)
327			if buf.Len() > maxLength*2 {
328				return gast.WalkStop, nil
329			}
330	
331			return gast.WalkContinue, nil
332		})
333	
334		if err != nil {
335			return "", err
336		}
337	
338		snippet := buf.String()
339	
340		// Truncate at word boundary if needed
341		if len(snippet) > maxLength {
342			snippet = truncateAtWord(snippet, maxLength)
343		}
344	
345		return strings.TrimSpace(snippet), nil
346	}

**Triggers (recomputation):**

- `UpdateMemo` — `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:447`, only when the update mask includes the `content` field (i.e., the memo's text actually changed).
- A batch backfill job, `Runner.RunOnce` in `server/runner/memopayload/runner.go:27-72`, which pages through all memos (100 at a time) and calls `RebuildMemoPayload` + `Store.UpdateMemo` for each. Note: unlike the sibling `s3presign.Runner` (wired into `server/server.go:162-163` and ticker-scheduled), this `memopayload.Runner` is never instantiated/called anywhere in `server.go` or elsewhere in the codebase — it exists as standalone rebuild logic (e.g., for manual/ops use) but isn't currently triggered automatically by the running server.

**Extracted properties** (from `ExtractedData` / `MemoPayload_Property`, `internal/markdown/markdown.go:20-25` and `proto/gen/store/memo.pb.go:85-95`):
- `Tags` — all `#tag` occurrences (deduped, case preserved), stored on `memo.Payload.Tags`.
- `Property.Title` — text of the first H1 heading if it's the document's first block.
- `Property.HasLink` — whether any Markdown link node is present.
- `Property.HasCode` — whether any code block/fenced code block/code span is present.
- `Property.HasTaskList` — whether any task checkbox (`- [ ]`/`- [x]`) is present.
- `Property.HasIncompleteTasks` — whether any unchecked task checkbox is present.
